selected.rationale: Ordering API is a core synchronous checkout path with a statically confirmed no-timeout contract; 100% packet loss will block the request until the client deadline, exposing unbounded latency and availability loss on webapp->ordering-api.
Same known no-timeout edge; injected delay propagates 1:1 into WebApp with no per-request timeout to truncate it, confirming unbounded latency propagation on webapp->ordering-api.
Catalog call from WebApp has a statically confirmed no-timeout contract; loss turns a routine catalog lookup into a hang, exposing the missing timeout on webapp->catalog-api.
Confirmed no-timeout synchronous path; delay is not bounded by any timeout or retry, making latency amplification directly observable on the webapp->catalog-api edge.

Basket is a core checkout/cart path from WebApp and follows the same synchronous client pattern; loss will block cart operations until the client budget, exposing availability loss on webapp->basket-api.
A delayed basket call propagates unboundedly through the synchronous WebApp client, likely exposing missing timeout or retry defenses on the webapp->basket-api edge.
Identity is a user-facing authentication dependency; loss on the synchronous webapp->identity-api call can hang login/authorization flows, exposing missing timeout behavior.
Identity call delay on the synchronous WebApp path cannot be absorbed by a per-request timeout, so it likely exposes unbounded latency propagation on webapp->identity-api.
Mobile BFF order placement is a core business path; loss on mobile-bff->ordering-api can hang mobile order requests and reveal a missing timeout or retry in the BFF.
Same BFF ordering path; delay is propagated synchronously and will be visible as unbounded latency if the BFF lacks a timeout, exposing the missing defense on mobile-bff->ordering-api.
